t: Gatwick Airport - Wikipedia
s: October 8, 2002 - London Gatwick Airport (/ˈɡætwɪk/) (IATA: LGW, ICAO: EGKK) is one of several international airports serving Greater London and southern England. It is located near Crawley, in West Sussex (30 miles (48 km) south of Central London), England. In 2024, Gatwick was the second-busiest airport by total passenger traffic in the UK, after Heathrow, and was the tenth-busiest in Europe by total passenger traffic.
